description: This file defines the NormalizerService class in the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods for normalizing objects and arrays of data, utilizing traits for common normalization functionality. It appears to be part of the core service layer of the application.

classes.name: NormalizerService
classes.description: A service class responsible for normalizing data objects into arrays, supporting both single objects and arrays.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a single object or data into an array, given a model class.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of data into an array format, given a model class.
